PowerShell(node -e "const sharp = require\('sharp'\); \(async \(\) => { const file = 'src/assets/brands/bms.png'; const { data, info } = await sharp\(file\).ensureAlpha\(\).raw\(\).toBuffer\({ resolveWithObject: true }\); const buf = Buffer.from\(data\); const bgR = buf[0], bgG = buf[1], bgB = buf[2]; console.log\('BG color sample:', bgR, bgG, bgB\); const tolerance = 25; let changed = 0; for \(let i = 0; i < buf.length; i += 4\) { const r = buf[i], g = buf[i+1], b = buf[i+2]; if \(Math.abs\(r - bgR\) <= tolerance && Math.abs\(g - bgG\) <= tolerance && Math.abs\(b - bgB\) <= tolerance\) { buf[i+3] = 0; changed++; } } console.log\('Pixels made transparent:', changed, 'of', buf.length/4\); await sharp\(buf, { raw: { width: info.width, height: info.height, channels: 4 } }\).png\({ compressionLevel: 9 }\).toFile\(file + '.new'\); require\('fs'\).renameSync\(file + '.new', file\); console.log\('Saved:', \(require\('fs'\).statSync\(file\).size/1024\).toFixed\(0\)+'KB'\); }\)\(\);")
